name: Eleven Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6200U or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 or equivalent integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Playable on low settings with integrated graphics.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth high settings and fast load times.

short_description: In Eleven, customize your ship with powerful lasers, adaptive shields, and precision thrusters. Choose colors, ships, and thrusters to match your style. Master zero-gravity mechanics and outmaneuver rivals in intense space battles where every choice matters.
